# Dealroom API

- [Dealroom API](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/index.md): Access startup, investor, and funding round data through the Dealroom REST API. Query entities, valuations, and taxonomy data programmatically.
- [Quickstart](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/getting-started/quickstart.md): Create an API key and make your first Dealroom API request, either with an AI coding agent or by hand.
- [Agent setup guide](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/getting-started/agent-setup.md): Instructions for an AI coding agent setting up the Dealroom API on a user's machine, from creating an API key to a first verified request.
- [Top fintech startups](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/examples/top-startups.md): Fetch the 10 most-funded fintech startups through the Dealroom API in cURL, Windows CMD, PowerShell, Node.js, or Python.
- [Analyse a funding market](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/examples/market-analysis.md): Measure how much capital a sector and region attract, how deal sizes have shifted, and which investors are most active.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/agent-apis/mcp.md): Connect AI agents to Dealroom data through the Dealroom MCP server. Install in Cursor, Claude Desktop, or any MCP-compatible client.
- [Authentication](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/getting-started/authentication.md): Prepare a production integration with API key scopes, token caching, credential rotation, and authentication failure handling.
- [Filtering](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/filtering.md): Narrow Dealroom API results with comparison operators, logical expressions, and filters discovered from the generated reference.
- [Pagination](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/pagination.md): Use the `cursor` query parameter to walk through results, with `limit` controlling page size and `include_total` opting into a total count.
- [Analytics and aggregates](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/aggregates.md): Compute grouped metrics, time series, funding distributions, and investor matches without downloading the underlying records.
- [Currencies](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/currencies.md): Request monetary fields, filters, and aggregate metrics in one of the currencies supported by the Dealroom API.
- [API versioning](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/versioning.md): Learn how the Dealroom API uses Stripe-style date-based versioning to handle breaking changes while keeping existing integrations stable.
- [Errors](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/errors.md): How the Dealroom API surfaces errors — response envelope, canonical error-code catalog, and common scenarios with example responses.
- [Rate limits](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/rate-limits.md): How the Dealroom API rate-limits requests, what a 429 response looks like, and how to raise your limit.
- [Credits](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/credits.md): How to read what each API call consumed from the X-Credits-Used response header, and what it does — and does not — mean during open beta.
- [Known limitations](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/concepts/known-limitations.md): Current data coverage and API constraints to account for when building with the Dealroom API.
- [Filters & Sorting](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/references/filters-and-sorting.md): Complete reference of available filters and sort keys for each API scope.
- [Entity](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/objects/entity.md): Field reference for the Entity object.
- [Investor](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/objects/investor.md): Field reference for the Investor object.
- [Fund](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/objects/fund.md): Field reference for the Fund object.
- [Transaction](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/objects/transaction.md): Field reference for the Transaction object.
- [Valuation](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/objects/valuation.md): Field reference for the Valuation object.
- [Founder / Person](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/objects/founder.md): Field reference for the Founder / Person object.
- [News Article](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/objects/news-article.md): Field reference for the News Article object.
- [Job](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/objects/job.md): Field reference for the Job object.
- [Discovery](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/discovery.md): API root discovery and functional namespaces.
- [API Root Discovery](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/discovery/api-root-discovery.md): Programmatic entry point for the Dealroom API. Returns available functional namespaces and links to documentation. Follow a namespace `url` to discover the resources it contains.
- [Analytics Namespace Discovery](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/discovery/analytics-namespace-discovery.md): Lists the resources available under the `analytics` namespace. Computed metrics: composable single- and multi-metric aggregates and yearly entity timeseries.
- [Data Namespace Discovery](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/discovery/data-namespace-discovery.md): Lists the resources available under the `data` namespace. Raw domain data: companies, investors, founders, people, funding rounds, valuations, news, jobs, and cross-resource search.
- [Reference Namespace Discovery](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/discovery/reference-namespace-discovery.md): Lists the resources available under the `reference` namespace. Taxonomy & discovery: filters and curated landscapes.
- [Entities](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/entities.md): Companies, investors, people, universities, and other organisations. Filter, sort, and paginate the unified entity index. The term `investor` refers to the investment firm; `fund` refers to the capital vehicle it raises.
- [List entities](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/entities/list-entities.md): Returns a paginated list of entities — the unified index across companies, investors, people, and universities. Each row is one of the per-class variants of the `Entity` union, selected by its own `type` and `organization_subtype`, and carries exactly the facets that class owns. Filter by 90+ keys (…
- [List entity geo points](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/entities/list-entity-geo-points.md): Lightweight endpoint designed to power map/geo visualizations, returning only id, name, lat, lon, country, and city. Supports the same filters as the entity list but with higher limits (up to 5000) and minimal payload.
- [Get single entity](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/entities/get-single-entity.md): Returns the full entity record by UUID (numeric IDs are not accepted). The response is one of the per-class variants of the `Entity` union — a company, university, gov/NGO, investor or person shape — selected by the row's own `type` and then its `organization_subtype`. Every variant carries the shar…
- [List LP fund positions](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/entities/list-lp-fund-positions.md): Lists the investor firms whose known limited partners include this entity — e.g. the accelerator programmes and VC firms a university has committed capital to. Each row is an investor-firm entity (not an `investment_fund` vehicle) and carries its investor type names. The source data holds only the L…
- [Companies](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/companies.md): Company profiles — the `organization_subtype = company` subset of entities (excludes investors, universities, and gov/NGOs). Same response shape as the entity index, scoped to companies.
- [List companies](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/list-companies.md): Returns a paginated list of companies (entities with `organization_subtype = company`) — the subset of the entity index that excludes investors, universities, and gov/NGOs. Supports the full entity filter syntax, sorting, and pagination. Monetary fields convert to the requested `?currency=` (default…
- [List company map points](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/list-company-map-points.md): Slim company payload for map rendering (the startup map's dot layer): one point per company with HQ coordinates and an optional `size_by` metric value. Accepts the same filter syntax as `/companies`. When `size_by` is set, points sort by that dimension descending, so capped responses keep the highes…
- [Get single company](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/get-single-company.md): Returns the full company record by UUID (numeric IDs are not accepted), including the `company` sub-object (unicorn/VC-backed flags, status, traffic) alongside the shared entity base fields. Monetary fields convert to the requested `?currency=` (default USD).
- [Get financials](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/get-financials.md): > ⚠ **DATA INCOMPLETE** — `profit` and `rnd` come from company filings (legacy `bobjects_financials` types 8 and 22), concentrated in companies with public annual reports. Measured coverage (2026-08-04): profit ~119k companies (slightly more than EBITDA's ~89k, well below revenue's ~295k); R&D ~19k…
- [List funding rounds](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/list-funding-rounds.md): Funding-related transactions (rounds, equity events, debt, grants) for a company, newest first. The same underlying transactions as the `/data/transactions` collection, scoped to this company, but in a slimmer shape — the collection's `entity_uuid`, `company`, `created_at`, and `deleted_at` fields a…
- [Get headcount breakdown](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/get-headcount-breakdown.md): Full monthly employee-distribution series for a company across both breakdown dimensions — `country` (employee distribution by country) and `department` — ordered chronologically (oldest first). Each row is one item's percentage share of headcount for a month. Narrow to a single dimension with `?typ…
- [List investors](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/list-investors.md): Investors that invested in the company, de-duplicated to one row per investor with their aggregate involvement. Includes investors not attributed to any disclosed round (`rounds_count: 0`); pass `?scope=additional` to fetch only those (they sort last, so large round-investor lists otherwise push the…
- [List company patents](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/list-company-patents.md): > ⚠ **PARTIAL IMPLEMENTATION** — `patents_count` (and the `patents` object's `total_value_usd`/`average_value_usd`) is sourced from PatSnap's `valued_patent_count` — every patent PatSnap assigned a value to. This list is sourced from the separate, PatSnap-curated `high_value_patent_pns` array, which…
- [List similar companies](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/list-similar-companies.md): Companies ranked by similarity to this company, scored by weighted overlap of shared categorical tags (sector, sub-industry, industry, client focus, technology, income stream) — the legacy app.dealroom.co similar-companies model. Force-sorted by score; supports the full company filter DSL to narrow…
- [List company team members](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/list-company-team-members.md): People associated with the company through the people_entities relationship (founders, executives, partners, and other team members). Supports the same person filter DSL as `/data/people`, plus `role` and `is_past` relationship filters.
- [List valuations](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/list-valuations.md): Valuation history (one row per recorded year/month) for a company. The `value` field converts to the requested `?currency=` (default USD).
- [Get web traffic](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/companies/get-web-traffic.md): Full monthly web-visit estimate series for a company, ordered chronologically (oldest first) — the data behind the web-traffic trend chart on the company profile. Visit counts are SimilarWeb-derived estimates. Returns an empty list for companies with no recorded traffic.
- [Universities](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/universities.md): University profiles — the `organization_subtype = university` subset of entities. The `university` sub-object carries alumni metrics.
- [List universities](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/universities/list-universities.md): Returns a paginated list of universities (entities with `organization_subtype = university`). The `university` sub-object carries alumni metrics (founder count, founded/unicorn companies). Supports the full entity filter syntax, sorting, and pagination.
- [List university map points](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/universities/list-university-map-points.md): Slim university payload for map rendering (the startup map's dot layer): one point per university with HQ coordinates and an optional `size_by` metric value. Accepts the same filter syntax as `/universities`. When `size_by` is set, points sort by that dimension descending, so capped responses keep t…
- [Get single university](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/universities/get-single-university.md): Returns the full university record by UUID (numeric IDs are not accepted), including the `university` sub-object (alumni metrics) alongside the shared entity base fields.
- [List alumni](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/universities/list-alumni.md): People who studied at the university (via people_education), one row per alum with the degree(s) earned and study years here, most recent first. Founder alumni carry `is_founder: true` so callers can surface them. Supports the same person filter DSL as `/data/people`.
- [List university patents](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/universities/list-university-patents.md): > ⚠ **PARTIAL IMPLEMENTATION** — Same as `companyPatents`: `patents_count` (`valued_patent_count`) and this list (`high_value_patent_pns`) are different PatSnap-internal populations. (ENG-960)
- [List university team members](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/universities/list-university-team-members.md): People associated with the university through the people_entities relationship. Supports the same person filter DSL as `/data/people`, plus `role` and `is_past` relationship filters.
- [Government & NGO](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/government-and-ngo.md): Government bodies and NGOs — the `organization_subtype = gov_ngo` subset of entities.
- [List government & NGO entities](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/government-&-ngo/list-government-&-ngo-entities.md): Returns a paginated list of government bodies and NGOs (entities with `organization_subtype = gov_ngo`). Supports the full entity filter syntax, sorting, and pagination.
- [List government & NGO map points](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/government-&-ngo/list-government-&-ngo-map-points.md): Slim government/NGO payload for map rendering (the startup map's dot layer): one point per entity with HQ coordinates and an optional `size_by` metric value. Accepts the same filter syntax as `/gov-ngo`. When `size_by` is set, points sort by that dimension descending, so capped responses keep the hi…
- [Get single government/NGO entity](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/government-&-ngo/get-single-governmentngo-entity.md): Returns the full government/NGO record by UUID (numeric IDs are not accepted), alongside the shared entity base fields.
- [List government & NGO patents](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/government-&-ngo/list-government-&-ngo-patents.md): > ⚠ **PARTIAL IMPLEMENTATION** — Same as `companyPatents`: `patents_count` (`valued_patent_count`) and this list (`high_value_patent_pns`) are different PatSnap-internal populations. (ENG-960)
- [List government & NGO team members](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/government-&-ngo/list-government-&-ngo-team-members.md): People associated with the government body or NGO through the people_entities relationship. Supports the same person filter DSL as `/data/people`, plus `role` and `is_past` relationship filters.
- [Transactions](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/transactions.md): Funding rounds, equity events, debt, grants, exits, and other company-level financial events.
- [List transactions](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/transactions/list-transactions.md): Lists company funding-related transactions (rounds, equity events, debt, grants). Supports the structured filter expression syntax shared with `/data/entities` and the same `limit` / `offset` / `sort` / `include_total` pagination model.
- [Valuations](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/valuations.md): Company valuation history by year and month.
- [List valuations](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/valuations/list-valuations.md): Returns the cross-entity valuation history. Each row is one company's recorded valuation at a specific year/month, with the valuation source where available. Use `/data/companies/{id}/valuations` for a single-entity view.
- [Investors](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/investors.md): Investor profiles (VCs, corporates, angels, family offices, governments). Subset of entities where `is_investor = true`. An investor is the firm that makes investments; the capital vehicles it raises are funds available via `/investors/{id}/funds`.
- [List investors](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/investors/list-investors.md): Returns a paginated list of investors (VCs, corporates, angels, etc.) with optional filters and sorting. All entities with is_investor=true are included. Use portfolio_count_tag and/or portfolio_count_location to compute a portfolio match count (number of investments matching specified tags/location…
- [List investor map points](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/investors/list-investor-map-points.md): Slim investor payload for map rendering (the startup map's dot layer): one point per investor with HQ coordinates and an optional `size_by` metric value. Accepts the same filter syntax as `/investors`. When `size_by` is set, points sort by that dimension descending, so capped responses keep the high…
- [Get single investor](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/investors/get-single-investor.md): Returns the full investor profile by UUID (numeric IDs are not accepted). Includes investor type, stages, deal-size ranges, portfolio summary (top companies, total rounds, size of the rounds participated in), and the underlying entity record. Monetary fields convert to the requested `?currency=`.
- [List funds](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/investors/list-funds.md): The individual fund vehicles this investor firm has raised (e.g. "Fund III", $200M, 2024), newest first. `amount` is the fund size in the requested `?currency=` (default USD); `amount_source` carries the original as-stored amount and native currency.
- [List LP fund positions](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/investors/list-lp-fund-positions.md): Investor firms whose known limited partners include this entity. Each row is an investor-firm entity (not a fund vehicle) with its investor type names.
- [List portfolio companies](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/investors/list-portfolio-companies.md): Portfolio companies this investor has backed, de-duplicated to one row per company with aggregate involvement. Includes investments not attributed to any disclosed round (`rounds_count: 0`). Sort by most recent round (default) or latest company valuation, and filter the companies with the same entit…
- [List similar investors](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/investors/list-similar-investors.md): Investors ranked by similarity to this investor, scored by weighted overlap of their investment-portfolio tags — the industries and sectors of the companies each has funded (the legacy investment_categories / investment_sectors signals). Force-sorted by score; supports the full investor filter DSL t…
- [List investor team members](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/investors/list-investor-team-members.md): People associated with the investor firm through the people_entities relationship (partners, executives, and other team members). Supports the same person filter DSL as `/data/people`, plus `role` and `is_past` relationship filters. Exposed on the investor lens because investor firms are not always…
- [Funds](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/funds.md): Funds — the capital vehicles investor firms raise (e.g. "Fund III", $200M, 2024). Browse/filter by manager, type, size, and vintage; each fund links to its manager (GP). Fund size (`amount`) converts to the requested `?currency=` (default USD); `amount_source` carries the original native-currency am…
- [List funds](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/funds/list-funds.md): Returns a paginated list of funds — the capital vehicles investor firms raise — newest first. Filter via the `filter` expression (`fund_type`, `is_closed`, `amount`, `year`, `investor_id`). Each fund links to its manager (GP). `amount` is the fund size in the requested `?currency=` (default USD); `a…
- [Get single fund](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/funds/get-single-fund.md): Returns one fund by its stable Dealroom fund id, including the manager (GP) that raised it. `amount` is the fund size in the requested `?currency=` (default USD); `amount_source` carries the original native amount.
- [People](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/people.md): Person profiles (founders, executives, angels, and others). Subset of entities where `entity_type = 'person'`. Same response shape as founders, with company associations, education, and tags.
- [List people](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/people/list-people.md): Returns a paginated list of all person entities (entity_type='person'), including company associations, education history, and tags (including professional backgrounds). Supports the same filter syntax as other endpoints.
- [Get single person](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/people/get-single-person.md): Returns the full person profile by UUID (numeric IDs are not accepted). Covers all person entities (founders, executives, angels, and others). Includes biographic details, professional history, education, and background tags.
- [List career history](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/people/list-career-history.md): The companies and other organizations this person is or was associated with through the people_entities relationship — with their role flags (founder / executive / partner), title(s), and tenure at each. De-duplicated to one row per organization, founding roles first, then current ones. Use `?role=`…
- [List education](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/people/list-education.md): The person's education records — degree, majors and years — each with the university as its summary row. Most recent first (`sort=-start_date`), the order the `education` glance on the person row uses.
- [Founders](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/founders.md): Founder profiles with company associations and education history. Subset of entities where `is_founder = true`.
- [List founders](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/founders/list-founders.md): Returns a paginated list of founders (entities with is_founder=true) with company associations, education history, and tags (including professional backgrounds). Supports the same filter syntax as other endpoints.
- [Get single founder](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/founders/get-single-founder.md): Returns the full founder profile by UUID (numeric IDs are not accepted). Includes biographic details, founder badges (super founder, serial founder, etc.), professional history, education, and links to founded companies.
- [List founded companies](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/founders/list-founded-companies.md): The companies (and other organizations) this person founded — a preset over the person career relationship filtered to the founder role. Same row shape as `/data/people/{id}/career`, newest tenure first. Supports the same entity `?filter[...]` DSL as `/data/companies`.
- [News](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/news.md): Curated news articles about companies, funds, deals, sectors, and events.
- [List news articles](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/news/list-news-articles.md): Returns a paginated list of published news articles. Articles can be about deals (VC rounds, IPOs, M&A), insights, events, partnerships, and more. Supports filtering by source, article type, sector, entity, and date range.
- [Get single news article](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/news/get-single-news-article.md): Returns one news article by numeric ID or slug, including its body excerpt, source, publish date, type, monetary amount (for deal articles, converted to the requested `?currency=`), and any linked Dealroom entities.
- [Jobs](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/jobs.md): Active job openings posted by companies, with hiring-trend signals.
- [List job openings](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/jobs/list-job-openings.md): > ⚠ **DATA INCOMPLETE** — `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `currency`, `department`, and `contract_type` are loaded from BigQuery but have <1% coverage (Predict Leads, ~99% of volume, does not supply them) and are intentionally not exposed in the API. The jobs table also covers active openings only (`exp…
- [Get single job opening](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/jobs/get-single-job-opening.md): > ⚠ **DATA INCOMPLETE** — Same as `listJobs`: `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `currency`, `department`, and `contract_type` are loaded but intentionally unexposed (<1% coverage), and the table covers active openings only (`expired = 0`).
- [Aggregate](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/aggregate.md): Composable single- and multi-metric aggregations across companies, funding rounds, valuations, founders, investors, entities, and fundings.
- [Aggregate by source](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/aggregate/aggregate-by-source.md): Query a specific source (founders, investors, companies, funding-rounds, valuations, entities, fundings) with structured filter syntax.
- [Multi-metric aggregate](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/aggregate/multi-metric-aggregate.md): Return multiple labeled metrics from a single SQL query, each with optional per-metric filters using aggregate FILTER (WHERE ...) clauses. Supports all metric types (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MEDIAN, MAX) and optional dimensional grouping (group_by).
- [Timeseries](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/timeseries.md): Yearly entity metrics (employees, revenue, valuation).
- [Timeseries](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/timeseries/timeseries.md): Returns yearly values for a single metric across filtered entities.
- [Filters](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/filters.md): Filter registry discovery and value lookup. Use `/reference/filters` to discover available filters per scope and `/reference/filters/:key/values` to look up valid values.
- [List filters](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/filters/list-filters.md): Returns available filters for the given scope with category grouping, operators, and optional user-facing descriptions and examples. Valid scopes: companies, investors, transactions, people, universities, gov_ngo, news, jobs, funds.
- [Search filters and values](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/filters/search-filters-and-values.md): Returns the picker-ready search result set for one scope: year-intent matches, value matches across every searchable dimension, and filter-name/description matches. Single round-trip replacement for the client-side fan-out across `/reference/filters/:key/values`.
- [List filter values](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/filters/list-filter-values.md): Returns values for a filter with entity counts. Supports fuzzy search, pagination, and optional metadata enrichment. Only filters with type id_lookup or enum have values.
- [Health](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/health.md): Liveness probe (public, unauthenticated).
- [Check API health](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/health/check-api-health.md): Public liveness probe. Returns `200` when the API can reach the database, `503` otherwise. No authentication required — safe to use from uptime monitors and load-balancer health checks.
- [Search](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/endpoint-overviews/search.md): Cross-resource fuzzy search across companies, investors, people, universities, and government & NGO bodies.
- [Search entities](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/api-reference/search/search-entities.md): Searches entities by name and alias and returns a flat, relevance-ranked array of matches (best first). Each row carries its `type` (`company` | `investor` | `person` | `university` | `gov_ngo`) plus the display fields `website_domain`, `hq_city`, and `hq_country` (any of which may be null). Use the…
- [Version history](https://developers.beta.dealroom.co/changelog.md): Breaking changes, deprecations, additions, and behavior changes across API versions.

## OpenAPI Specs

- [openapi](/openapi.yaml)
